question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Candidates who successfully complete the entrance test will be ______ for an interview next week.
solution:
The correct answer is "**invited**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Invite** means **calling a person** to come at a particular place at a particular time **in a courteous and encouraging manner**. 

 
 
• **Example:** *I need to **invite** my friends for tomorrow's party. *
